privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.collect1: We collect your name, email and, if you choose, your phone number, so you can log in and report faults.
privacy.collect2: We also keep your home ward and the date and time you agreed to this notice.
privacy.collect3: When you report a fault, we keep its photos and, if you allow it, its GPS location.
privacy.collect4: FixMyKasi is only for people aged 18 or older, so we do not collect children's information.
privacy.why1: Your name is shown on your own profile.
privacy.why2: Your email is used to log in and for account emails.
privacy.why3: Your phone number lets your ward admin contact you about a fault.
privacy.why4: Your home ward is the default ward for your reports.
privacy.why5: Fault photos and locations show where a fault is and prove that it is there.
privacy.who1: You and your ward admin can see your name, email and phone number.
privacy.who2: Only you can see your home ward.
privacy.who3: Everyone can see fault photos and fault locations. A fault's location is where the fault is, not where you live.
privacy.who4: Public screens never show your name, email or phone number.
privacy.where1: Your information and fault photos are stored with Supabase in Europe (Stockholm, Sweden), which is outside South Africa.
privacy.keep1: We keep your name, email and home ward until you delete your account.
privacy.keep2: We keep your phone number until you remove it on your profile or delete your account.
privacy.keep3: Fault photos and locations stay for as long as the fault exists. After you delete your account, they are no longer linked to you.
privacy.delete1: Go to Profile and Settings and tap "Delete account". Your login, profile and upvotes are deleted straight away.
privacy.delete2: Faults you reported stay public because neighbours rely on them, but they are no longer linked to you.
